criteria: Local head and carrier agree explicit home/source/commodity/quantity/advance/30day scope, using house funds and shared monthly budget, never private money or undisclosed remote stock
Actual carrier travel to source, local stock and live price check, separate entrusted cash/cargo, shared100kg capacity and no private resale or teleport delivery

Actual home return and local head or explicitly scoped present proxy receipt transfer goods and unused advance to the original house exactly once, with immutable receiver evidence and merchant/house/cargo/private conservation

Carrier withdrawal, expiry, absence and lost authority prevent new buying while retaining entrusted cash/cargo and return obligations; physical proxy revocation blocks proxy receipt, with stale/repeated/forged inputs atomic

Explicit v10 normal entry and bounded local UI, legacy v9 bytes, real generation recovery/future equality across dispatch/travel/purchase/withdrawal/receipt, Game build and headless Node3D; no GUI acceptance claim
target_meaning: House-funded physical procurement carried by the player as head or direct retainer under a bounded local agreement. Not remote shopping, automated NPC caravans, private profit, generic principal remote cancellation or historic economics. Includes explicit v10 scoped proxy receipt of house cargo/unused cash and immutable dated receiving proof. No automatic NPC transport.
extension_meaning: Extend the same physical procurement loop through locally authorized proxy receipt when the principal is absent. The old five criteria and targets remain preserved in v9; head receipt stays supported. No reassessment credit, weights or denominator change.
